headline: HuyenBao v11.41 — sticky dashboard+menu, tách học vấn/sự nghiệp, gộp xã hội+cộng đồng, ẩn vũ trụ, sửa icon đế chế
summary: MENU RESTRUCTURE. (1) STICKY HEADER: PinZone + gnav + subnav merged into ONE sticky block — menu never scrolls away, never overflows sides. Max-width narrowed 920px→860px. (2) EDUCATION SPLIT from Career: Education = degrees/licences/courses; Career = jobs + experience + contracts + raise. Experience feeds Workshop repair. (3) SPACE HIDDEN: Cosmic tab now lives in Empire group, hidden until player reaches 'empire' entity tier (interstellar). (4) SOCIAL+COMMUNITY MERGED: one 'Network' group with 6 sub-tabs — Social/Relations/Clubs (AI NPCs) + Friends/Chat/Leaderboard (real players). (5) EMPIRE ICON FIXED: was cup (t-rank), now building (b-corp) = empire/conglomerate visual. (6) EMPIRE GUIDANCE: new 'Your path to empire' card in EntityTab explains current tier + what to do next + why each threshold matters, in EN/VI/ZH.
features: STICKY HEADER: PinZone + gnav + subnav in one pinned block (position:sticky, max-width:860px, blur backdrop)
NARROWER: .wrap max-width 920px→860px so content doesn't spread too wide
EDUCATION SPLIT: separate 'edu' group (was inside 'growth' with Career)
CAREER SEPARATE: 'career' group with experience + contracts + raise (experience feeds Workshop)
SPACE HIDDEN: Cosmic tab in Empire group, gated behind entityTierOf(s)==='empire'||'federation'
NETWORK MERGED: Social+Community → one 'network' group (6 sub-tabs: Social/Relations/Clubs/Friends/Chat/Leaderboard)
EMPIRE ICON: t-rank cup → b-corp building (empire/conglomerate visual)
EMPIRE GUIDANCE: 'Your path to empire' card with tier-specific what-to-do + next-tier progress
i18n: empire.guide.* + empire.next/ready + tab.space/entity + grp.edu/career in EN/VI/ZH
